preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analyzer WHERE id = 900001 AND name = 'Empty draft' AND is_active IS TRUE AND status = 'SETUP' AND bridge_connection_id IS NULL AND mapping_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analyzer WHERE id = 900002 AND is_active IS FALSE AND status = 'INACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analyzer WHERE id = 900003 AND name = 'Migrated fixture' AND is_active IS FALSE AND status = 'INACTIVE' AND mapping_id IS NULL AND bridge_connection_id = 'bridge-upgrade-fixture' AND test_unit_ids = '1,2' AND latest_activation_record_id = 900003

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analyzer WHERE id = 900004 AND name = 'Second migrated fixture' AND is_active IS FALSE AND status = 'INACTIVE' AND mapping_id IS NULL AND bridge_connection_id = 'bridge-upgrade-fixture-2' AND test_unit_ids = '2'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analyzer_activation_record WHERE id = 900003 AND analyzer_id = 900003 AND mapping_id IS NULL AND verification_confirmation_id IS NULL AND runtime_fingerprint = 'sha256:' || repeat('d', 64)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run WHERE source = 'ANALYZER_MAPPING' AND status = 'EXPORTED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzers') d WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_MAPPING' AND (d->>'id')::numeric IN (900003, 900004) AND (d->>'site_binding_revision_id')::numeric = 900003

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzer_site_binding_test') t WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_MAPPING' AND (t->>'site_binding_revision_id')::numeric = 900003 AND t->>'source_row_key' = 'upgrade-test' AND t->>'mapping_state' = 'BOUND'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzer_profile_binding') p WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_MAPPING' AND p->>'profile_id' = 'upgrade-fixture'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzer_site_binding_revision') v WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_MAPPING' AND (v->>'id')::numeric = 900005

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzer_activation_record') a WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_MAPPING' AND (a->>'id')::numeric = 900003 AND (a->>'site_binding_revision_id')::numeric = 900003
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run WHERE source = 'ANALYZER_LEGACY' AND status = 'EXPORTED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzers') d WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_LEGACY' AND (d->>'id')::numeric = 900001 AND d->>'analyzer_type' = 'HEMATOLOGY'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzers') d WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_LEGACY' AND (d->>'id')::numeric = 900003 AND d->>'machine_id' = 'legacy-fixture' AND d->>'bridge_connection_id' = 'bridge-upgrade-fixture'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_import_run r, jsonb_array_elements(r.summary::jsonb->'analyzer_test_map') m WHERE r.source = 'ANALYZER_LEGACY' AND (m->>'analyzer_id')::numeric = 900003 AND m->>'analyzer_test_name' = 'upgrade-test'
